name: Strava Daily Digest
headline: Catch up.

Move on.
sentence: Your Strava following feed goes in. One tidy page per day comes out, with one-tap kudos and comment ideas.

facts: Free · iPhone and iPad · Runs in the free Scriptable app · Needs a Strava account · AI is optional, with your own Claude or OpenAI key
bannerAlt: Strava Daily Digest: Catch up. Cheer. Move on. Your Strava following feed goes in, one tidy page per day with one-tap kudos and comment ideas comes out. Two iPhone screens show the daily digest and the day as a comic, with a route from a teal start dot to a rose finish dot.
